en-US.title: Eryptosis
en-US.description: The Ca2+-driven, PS-exposing regulated death of mature anucleate erythrocytes — Gardos K+ efflux, scramblase activation, calpain blebbing, caspase-8 fate switching against erythronecroptosis, rapid efferocytotic clearance before hemolysis, and its druggability.

zh-TW.title: Eryptosis
zh-TW.description: 無核紅血球類凋亡式的受調控死亡——Ca2+ 內流、calpain／scramblase 活化、磷脂醯絲胺酸外露——最終靜默地被脾臟清除。

en-US.title: SIRT3
en-US.description: SIRT3 (Sirtuin 3) is the primary NAD+-dependent deacetylase localized within the Mitochondria.

zh-TW.title: SIRT3
zh-TW.description: SIRT3 (Sirtuin 3) 是主要定位於粒線體內的 NAD+-依賴性去乙醯化酶。

en-US.title: SIRT6

en-US.title: Inflammaging
en-US.description: Inflammaging is a state of chronic, low-grade, systemic inflammation that develops with advanced age and is a major risk factor for many age-related diseases.

zh-TW.title: Inflammaging（發炎性老化）
zh-TW.description: 發炎性老化是一種隨著年齡增長而形成的慢性、低度、全身性發炎狀態，是許多年齡相關疾病的主要風險因子。

en-US.title: cGAS-STING Pathway
en-US.description: The cGAS-STING complex is an innate immune sensor that detects cytoplasmic DNA and activates inflammatory interferon signalling, playing a crucial role in SASP activation and age-related inflammation.

en-US.title: Sirtuins
en-US.description: Sirtuins (SIRTs) are a highly conserved family of nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD⁺)-dependent enzymes belonging to Class III histone deacetylases (HDACs). Spanning all domains of life, sirtu...

zh-TW.title: Sirtuins（sirtuin 家族）
zh-TW.description: Sirtuins（SIRTs）是一類高度保守的菸鹼醯胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（NAD⁺）依賴性酵素，屬於第 III 類組蛋白去乙醯化酶（HDACs）。遍布所有生命領域，sirtuin 扮演代謝感受器的角色，...

en-US.title: SIRT2
en-US.description: SIRT2 (Sirtuin 2) is a member of the sirtuin family of NAD+-dependent deacetylases, primarily localized in the cytosol.

zh-TW.title: SIRT2
zh-TW.description: SIRT2（Sirtuin 2）是 NAD+ 依賴型去乙醯化酶 sirtuin 家族的成員，主要定位於細胞質。

en-US.title: SIRT4

en-US.title: SIRT5
en-US.description: SIRT5 (Sirtuin 5) is a mitochondrial sirtuin and the sole mammalian member of phylogenetic Class III sirtuins — a class distributed widely in all prokaryotes (both bacteria and archaea). This deep ...

en-US.title: SIRT7
en-US.description: SIRT7 (Sirtuin 7) is a nuclear/nucleolar sirtuin classified in phylogenetic Class IVb — the same class as SIRT6 (Class IVa). Class IV sirtuins are absent from prokaryotes but broadly distributed in...

en-US.title: Apoptosis
en-US.description: Apoptosis (programmed cell death) is a highly regulated mechanism for removing damaged, infected, redundant, or potentially cancerous cells without inducing inflammation.

zh-TW.title: Apoptosis
zh-TW.description: 凋亡（程式性細胞死亡）是一種高度受調控的機制，可在不引發發炎的情況下清除受損、感染、多餘或具潛在癌變風險的細胞。

en-US.title: Autophagy
en-US.description: Cellular degradation pathway that delivers cytoplasmic material to lysosomes for recycling; maintains energy homeostasis and quality control.

zh-TW.title: Autophagy
zh-TW.description: 將細胞質物質送至溶酶體以進行回收的細胞降解路徑；維持能量恆定與品質管制。

en-US.title: STING
en-US.description: Stimulator of interferon genes, a signaling protein that plays a key role in innate immunity by sensing cytosolic DNA.

en-US.title: HIF-1α
en-US.description: Hypoxia-inducible factor 1 alpha; master transcriptional regulator of the hypoxic response, repressed by SIRT6 and de-repressed by SIRT3 loss.

en-US.title: TNFα
en-US.description: Tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNFα) is a pleiotropic pro-inflammatory cytokine produced primarily by activated Macrophages, T Cells, and Natural Killer Cells. It is a master regulator of the inf...

en-US.title: BDNF
en-US.description: BDNF (Brain-Derived Neurotrophic Factor) is a member of the Neurotrophin family of growth factors that supports neuronal survival, differentiation, synaptic plasticity, and neurogenesis. It is critical for learning, memory, and mood regulation.

en-US.title: Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype
en-US.description: The senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) is a complex mixture of cytokines, chemokines, growth factors, matrix metalloproteinases, bioactive lipids, extracellular vesicles, and non-coding nucleic acids secreted by senescent cells, mediating paracrine and systemic effects on the tissue microenvironment.

zh-TW.title: Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype
zh-TW.description: 衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）是衰老細胞分泌的一複雜混合物，包含細胞激素、趨化因子、生長因子、基質金屬蛋白酶、生物活性脂質、細胞外囊泡與非編碼核酸，對組織微環境介導旁分泌與全身性效應。

en-US.title: NAMPT
en-US.description: NAMPT (Nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase) is a key enzyme in the salvage pathway of NAD+ biosynthesis, whose levels decrease significantly in various tissues during aging.

en-US.title: Immunosenescence
en-US.description: Immunosenescence refers to the gradual deterioration of the immune system associated with aging, leading to increased susceptibility to infections, autoimmune diseases, and cancer.

en-US.title: Neutrophils
en-US.description: Neutrophils (also known as polymorphonuclear leukocytes or granulocytes) are the most abundant type of white blood cell and serve as the first line of defense in the innate immune system.

en-US.title: Senolytic Therapy
en-US.description: Therapeutic strategies that selectively eliminate senescent cells by disabling their anti-apoptotic survival pathways, reducing senescence burden and SASP-driven pathology.

en-US.title: PIP5KI
en-US.description: PIP5KI refers to the type I phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate 5-kinases (PIP5K1A, PIP5K1B, PIP5K1C) that phosphorylate PtdIns4P to PtdIns(4,5)P2; a distinct type II family (PIP4K2A-C, formerly PIP5K2) makes PI5P instead, and the two are being pursued as cancer targets.

en-US.title: FoxO1
en-US.description: Transcription factor regulated by Akt that controls gluconeogenesis, adipogenesis, and beta-cell function.

en-US.title: LXRα
en-US.description: Liver X receptor alpha (LXRα) is a nuclear receptor that plays a central role in the regulation of Cholesterol, fatty acid, and glucose homeostasis. It works in conjunction with other receptors lik...

en-US.title: Gasdermin D
en-US.description: A pore-forming effector protein cleaved by inflammatory caspases to execute pyroptosis and drive IL-1 family cytokine release.

en-US.title: CD4+ T Cells
en-US.description: CD4-positive T helper cells are central coordinators of adaptive immunity, orchestrating immune responses through cytokine production and helper functions.

en-US.title: PPARγ
en-US.description: Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARγ) is a nuclear receptor that regulates fatty acid storage and glucose metabolism. It is a key target for treating Diabetes Mellitus and plays ...

en-US.title: CD47
en-US.description: CD47 is a ubiquitously expressed immunoglobulin-superfamily receptor that pairs with SIRP-alpha on myeloid cells to deliver a "don't eat me" signal suppressing phagocytosis; blockade of CD47 is a cancer and fibrosis immunotherapy strategy.

zh-TW.title: CD47
zh-TW.description: CD47 是廣泛表現的免疫球蛋白超家族受體，與骨髓細胞上的 SIRPα 配對傳遞「don't eat me」訊號以抑制吞噬作用；阻斷 CD47 是癌症與纖維化的免疫治療策略。

en-US.title: Hematopoietic Stem Cell
en-US.description: Multipotent stem cells that give rise to all blood cell types through haematopoiesis

en-US.title: Sir2 (yeast)
en-US.description: Sir2 (Silent Information Regulator 2) from _Saccharomyces cerevisiae_ is the founding member of the sirtuin family of proteins. Originally discovered as MAR1 (mating-type regulator 1) and subsequen...

en-US.title: cAMP Response Element Binding Protein (CREB)
en-US.description: cAMP Response Element Binding Protein (CREB/CREB1) is a 43 kDa basic leucine zipper (bZIP) transcription factor that binds cAMP response elements (CRE) in target gene promoters. It integrates cAMP, Ca2+/calmodulin, and growth factor signals.

en-US.title: Efferocytosis
en-US.description: PS-dependent phagocytic clearance of apoptotic cells; in erythrocytes it removes eryptotic RBCs within minutes, reprograms macrophages toward an antiinflammatory/antioxidant (HO-1) phenotype, and thereby suppresses DAMP-driven inflammation from hemolysis.

zh-TW.title: Efferocytosis
zh-TW.description: 依賴 PS 的凋亡細胞吞噬清除；在紅血球中，它在數分鐘內移除 eryptotic RBC，將巨噬細胞重新編排為抗發炎／抗氧化（HO-1）表型，藉此抑制溶血驅動的 DAMP 發炎。

en-US.title: Hematopoiesis
en-US.description: Hematopoiesis is the lifelong process of blood-cell formation from hematopoietic stem cells in the bone marrow, governed by transcription factors, cytokines, and the niche, and declining with age.

en-US.title: Gluconeogenesis
en-US.description: Definition: Gluconeogenesis is a fundamental biological process that maintains cellular and organismal homeostasis. It involves coordinated molecular events regulated by signaling pathways and ...

en-US.title: AceCS2
en-US.description: AceCS2 (Acetyl-CoA Synthetase 2, mitochondrial; encoded by ACSS1) is a mitochondrial matrix enzyme that catalyzes the ATP-dependent conversion of acetate and CoA into acetyl-CoA feeding acetate carbon into the TCA cycle for ATP generation.

en-US.title: NETosis
en-US.description: Regulated neutrophil death with extrusion of neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) — decondensed chromatin plus histones, elastase, and myeloperoxidase — via largely PAD4-mediated histone citrullination.

en-US.title: PD-L1
en-US.description: Programmed death-ligand 1 (CD274/B7-H1); a transmembrane protein that inhibits T-cell function by binding PD-1, serving as a key immune checkpoint in cancer and a target modulated by SASP signaling in the senescent tumor microenvironment.

zh-TW.title: PD-L1
zh-TW.description: 程式性死亡配體 1（CD274/B7-H1）；一種透過結合 PD-1 抑制 T 細胞功能的跨膜蛋白，是癌症中關鍵的免疫檢查點，也是衰老腫瘤微環境中 SASP 訊號調節的標的。

en-US.title: SUV39H1
en-US.description: Suppressor of variegation 3-9 homolog 1 (KMT1A), the H3K9 trimethyltransferase whose senescence-associated decline licenses H3K9 demethylation and SASP expression.

en-US.title: UCP2
en-US.description: UCP2 (Uncoupling Protein 2) is a mitochondrial inner membrane transporter protein belonging to the family of mitochondrial uncoupling proteins, which uncouple oxygen consumption from ATP synthesis by facilitating proton leak across the inner mitochondrial membrane.

en-US.title: SRT1720
en-US.description: SRT1720 is a synthetic small-molecule STAC (sirtuin activating compound) developed by Sirtris Pharmaceuticals as a potent SIRT1 activator. It belongs to the imidazothiazole class and is structurally distinct from resveratrol.

en-US.title: Reactive Oxygen Species
en-US.description: Reactive Oxygen Species (ROS) are highly reactive molecules containing oxygen, formed as natural byproducts of oxygen metabolism. They play dual roles as signaling molecules and agents of oxida...

zh-TW.title: Reactive Oxygen Species（活性氧）
zh-TW.description: 活性氧（ROS）是含氧的高反應性分子，為氧代謝的自然副產物。它們兼具訊號傳遞分子與氧化性損傷因子的雙重角色……

en-US.title: CCL5
en-US.description: C-C motif chemokine ligand 5 (RANTES), a SASP chemokine that binds CCR1/3/5 and promotes cancer progression and reproductive aging.

en-US.title: PAD4
en-US.description: Peptidylarginine deiminase 4 — the calcium-dependent histone-citrullinating enzyme that drives chromatin decondensation in NETosis and marks cit-H3-positive inflammatory death.

en-US.title: Cancer
en-US.description: Cancer is a large group of diseases characterized by uncontrolled cell growth with the potential to invade or spread to other parts of the body. It shares a "meta-hallmark" of epigenetic instabilit...

zh-TW.title: 癌症
zh-TW.description: 癌症是一大群以細胞失控生長為特徵的疾病，並具有侵入或擴散至身體其他部位的潛能。它與老化共享「後表觀遺傳不穩定」這項「後徵象」。

en-US.title: TFAM
en-US.description: Mitochondrial transcription factor A, a nuclear-encoded regulator of mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription, and nucleoid architecture; induced by mTOR inhibition to support mitochondrial renewal.

en-US.title: Neutrophil Elastase
en-US.description: The azurophil-granule serine protease (ELANE) that degrades chromatin packaging and decorates NETs — effector and marker of NETosis alongside MPO and cit-H3.

en-US.title: Bone Marrow
en-US.description: Bone Marrow is a semi-solid tissue found within the spongy (trabecular) portions of bones. It is the primary site of Hematopoiesis — the production of all blood cell lineages — in adult mammals.

en-US.title: Histone H1
en-US.description: Histone H1 (Linker Histone H1) is a family of basic nuclear proteins that bind to linker DNA between nucleosomes, facilitating higher-order chromatin structure and compaction. Unlike core histo...

en-US.title: CRTC2
en-US.description: CREB-regulated transcriptional coactivator 2 (CRTC2, also TORC2) is a coactivator that drives hepatic gluconeogenesis; it is regulated by phosphorylation (SIK/AMPK) and by sirtuin deacetylation.

en-US.title: HIC1
en-US.description: HIC1 (Hypermethylated in Cancer 1) is a sequence-specific zinc-finger transcriptional repressor containing an N-terminal POZ/BTB domain. It is a critical tumour suppressor gene located in a genomic...

en-US.title: B2M
en-US.description: Beta-2 microglobulin, the invariant light chain of MHC class I molecules; a senescence surface marker used for targeted senolytic delivery and a plasma protein surrogate in the DNAmGrimAge epigenetic clock.

zh-TW.title: B2M
zh-TW.description: β2-微小球蛋白，MHC 第一類分子的不變輕鏈；一種用於靶向 senolytic 遞送的衰老表面標記，以及 DNAmGrimAge 表觀遺傳時鐘中的血漿蛋白代理。

en-US.title: PECAM1
en-US.description: Platelet endothelial cell adhesion molecule 1 (CD31), a transmembrane glycoprotein expressed on endothelial cells and immune cells

zh-TW.title: PECAM1
zh-TW.description: 血小板內皮細胞黏附分子 1（CD31），一種表現於內皮細胞與免疫細胞的跨膜醣蛋白

en-US.title: Caspase-11
en-US.description: Mouse inflammatory caspase of the non-canonical inflammasome; detects cytosolic LPS, cleaves gasdermin D to form pyroptotic pores, and participates in IL-1α processing relevant to the SASP.

en-US.title: FK866
en-US.description: FK866 is a potent, specific inhibitor of the NAD+ salvage enzyme NAMPT used to deplete intracellular NAD+ and thereby induce CD8+ T-cell senescence in experimental models of ulcerative colitis.

en-US.title: Senescent CD8+ T Cells
en-US.description: Senescent CD8+ T cells are a pathogenic, prematurely senescent cytotoxic T-cell population in ulcerative colitis, induced by NAD+ metabolic dysregulation via mitochondrial dysfunction and cGAS-STING signaling, and cleared by senolytic therapy.

en-US.title: NAD+ Metabolic Reprogramming
en-US.description: NAD+ metabolic reprogramming is the mucosal imbalance of impaired NAD+ biosynthesis and heightened NAD+ consumption that depletes NAD+ in ulcerative colitis and drives CD8+ T-cell senescence via mitochondrial dysfunction and cGAS-STING signaling.

en-US.title: T Cell Exhaustion
en-US.description: T cell exhaustion is a hypofunctional, adaptive T-cell state defined by inhibitory checkpoint upregulation (PD-1, CTLA-4, LAG-3, TIM-3) that is mechanistically distinct from the bioactive, SASP-secreting senescent state of CD8+ T cells.

en-US.title: Ulcerative Colitis
en-US.description: Ulcerative colitis is a chronic inflammatory bowel disease of the colonic mucosa in which NAD+ metabolic dysregulation-driven senescence of CD8+ T cells contributes to pathogenesis and predicts non-response to biologic therapy.

en-US.title: Thrombosis
en-US.description: Pathological intravascular clot formation associated with vital NETosis and NET-driven immunothrombosis.

en-US.title: Cytotoxic CD4+ T Cells
en-US.description: Effector CD4+ T cells (CD4 CTLs) expressing EOMES, CD38, CCL5, perforin and granzymes that expand during aging, accumulate in the bone marrow, and drive CCL5–CCR5-dependent myelopoiesis while retaining senescent-cell killing capacity.

en-US.title: Dextran Sulfate Sodium
en-US.description: Dextran sulfate sodium (DSS) is a sulfated polysaccharide that, when given in drinking water, produces a chemical colitis model mimicking key features of human ulcerative colitis; cyclical 3% DSS was used to model chronic colitis in the Ye 2026 study.

en-US.title: Adoptive Transfer
en-US.description: Adoptive transfer is the experimental transfer of isolated cells into a recipient organism; in the Ye 2026 study, transfer of FK866-induced senescent CD8+ T cells into DSS-colitic mice demonstrates that these cells directly exacerbate ulcerative colitis.

en-US.title: Gene Set Enrichment Analysis
en-US.description: Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) is a computational method that tests whether a predefined gene set is over-represented at the extremes of a ranked gene list; in the Ye 2026 study it identified enrichment of the NAD+ metabolism pathway and of inflammatory pathways in senescent CD8+ T cells.

en-US.title: Nicotinate and Nicotinamide Metabolism
en-US.description: Nicotinate and nicotinamide metabolism is the KEGG pathway encompassing NAD+ biosynthesis, salvage and consumption; its enrichment in colitic mucosa and senescent CD8+ T cells defines the NAD+ metabolic reprogramming that drives ulcerative colitis.

en-US.title: LAG-3
en-US.description: LAG-3 (CD223) is an inhibitory immune-checkpoint receptor on T cells; its expression is unchanged in senescent CD8+ T cells in ulcerative colitis, serving as a key negative marker that distinguishes senescence from T cell exhaustion.

en-US.title: KLRG1
en-US.description: KLRG1 is an inhibitory C-type lectin-like receptor used as a marker of terminally differentiated and senescent T cells; the CD27-KLRG1+ phenotype operationally defines the senescent CD8+ T-cell population in ulcerative colitis.

en-US.title: diABZI
en-US.description: diABZI (compound 3) is a potent non-nucleotide dimeric amidobenzimidazole STING agonist; in the Ye 2026 study direct STING hyperactivation by diABZI recapitulates CD8+ T-cell senescence by inducing p16 and p21.

en-US.title: Ionomycin
en-US.description: Calcium ionophore used to induce PAD4-dependent vital NETosis in neutrophils.

en-US.title: CD27
en-US.description: CD27 is a TNFR-superfamily co-stimulatory receptor on T cells whose loss marks terminally differentiated and senescent T cells; CD27-KLRG1+ CD8+ T cells are the pathogenic senescent subset in ulcerative colitis.

en-US.title: Perforin
en-US.description: Perforin (PRF1) is a pore-forming cytotoxic protein of NK-cell and CD8+ T-cell granules whose expression declines in senescent CD8+ T cells, marking the loss of cytotoxic function that accompanies the senescence-associated secretory phenotype.

en-US.title: Spatial Transcriptomics
en-US.description: Spatial transcriptomics maps gene expression within intact tissue sections; in the Ye 2026 study it localizes senescent CD8+ T cells to mucosal niches with high NAD+ metabolism scores in ulcerative colitis.

en-US.title: VBIT-4
en-US.description: VBIT-4 is a small-molecule inhibitor of VDAC1 oligomerization that blocks mitochondrial DNA release into the cytosol; in the Ye 2026 study it abolishes cytosolic mtDNA accumulation and reduces CD8+ T-cell senescence.

en-US.title: C178
en-US.description: C-178 is a covalent small-molecule STING inhibitor that binds Cys91 of murine STING and blocks activation-associated palmitoylation; in the Ye 2026 study it rescues FK866-induced CD8+ T-cell senescence.

en-US.title: Granzyme B
en-US.description: Granzyme B (GZMB) is a serine protease of cytotoxic granules that induces apoptosis in target cells; its expression declines in senescent CD8+ T cells as cytotoxic function is replaced by a pro-inflammatory SASP.

en-US.title: CCR5
en-US.description: CC chemokine receptor 5 (CD195), a Gαi-coupled GPCR and principal receptor for CCL5; upregulated on aged hematopoietic progenitors where it mediates T cell-driven myelopoiesis, and the target of maraviroc.

en-US.title: Infliximab
en-US.description: Infliximab is a chimeric IgG1 monoclonal antibody against TNF-alpha used in inflammatory bowel disease; in the Ye 2026 ulcerative colitis cohort, high NAD+-senescence scores predict primary non-response to infliximab.

en-US.title: Vedolizumab
en-US.description: Vedolizumab is a gut-selective humanized monoclonal antibody against the alpha4beta7 integrin used in ulcerative colitis; in the Ye 2026 GSE73661 cohort, high NAD+-senescence scores predict non-response to vedolizumab.

en-US.title: Suicidal NETosis
en-US.description: Lytic NETosis pathway in which NADPH oxidase-derived ROS, MPO-mediated neutrophil elastase release, and GSDMD pore formation drive chromatin decondensation, plasma-membrane rupture, and neutrophil death.

en-US.title: Myelopoiesis
en-US.description: Production of myeloid lineage cells (granulocytes, monocytes, macrophages) from hematopoietic progenitors; biased expansion during aging via CCL5–CCR5 signaling raises the neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio.

en-US.title: Neutrophil Extracellular Traps
en-US.description: Extracellular webs of decondensed neutrophil DNA decorated with histones and granule antimicrobial proteins that entrap microbes and restrict pathogen dissemination.

en-US.title: Noncanonical NETosis
en-US.description: Lytic NETosis pathway triggered by cytosolic Gram-negative bacterial LPS sensed by the noncanonical inflammasome, driving caspase-4/11- and GSDMD-dependent NET extrusion independently of NE, MPO, and PAD4.

en-US.title: Vital NETosis
en-US.description: Rapid, PAD4- and calcium-dependent NETosis pathway in which neutrophils externalize chromatin by nuclear blebbing without plasma-membrane permeabilization, remaining viable and motile after NET release.

en-US.title: Glycolysis
en-US.description: Glycolysis is the metabolic pathway that converts glucose into pyruvate. A byproduct of this pathway is the formation of Methylglyoxal, a potent precursor for Advanced Glycation End Products.

zh-TW.title: Glycolysis
zh-TW.description: 糖解作用是將葡萄糖轉換為丙酮酸的代謝途徑。此途徑的副產物之一是甲基乙二醛（Methylglyoxal），為晚期糖化終產物的強效前驅物。

en-US.title: Maraviroc
en-US.description: FDA-approved CCR5 antagonist (HIV-1 entry inhibitor) that in aged mice normalizes CCL5-CCR5-driven myelopoiesis, lowers the neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio and inflammaging cytokines, and improves metabolic and functional healthspan outcomes.

en-US.title: DBC1
en-US.description: Deleted in bladder cancer 1 (CCAR2) — tumor suppressor that binds the SIRT1 N-terminus and inhibits its deacetylase activity; silencing of DBC1 and HIC1 in cancers unleashes SIRT1.

en-US.title: POMC
en-US.description: Pro-opiomelanocortin — precursor polypeptide cleaved into ACTH, alpha-MSH and beta-endorphin; hypothalamic arcuate POMC neurons are a SIRT1-regulated feeding-behavior node under dietary restriction.

en-US.title: HIF2α
en-US.description: Hypoxia-inducible factor 2 alpha — activated by SIRT1 deacetylation under hypoxia, opposite to SIRT1's inhibition of HIF-1alpha; falls as NAD+ and SIRT1 decline, proposing a HIF2alpha-to-HIF1alpha switch.

en-US.title: miR-134
en-US.description: Brain-enriched microRNA repressed by SIRT1 to permit CREB and BDNF expression; the SIRT1–miR-134–CREB–BDNF axis promotes memory formation and synaptic plasticity.

en-US.title: BESTO Mice
en-US.description: Beta-cell-specific SIRT1 transgenic (RIP-SIRT1) mouse model — SIRT1 overexpression in pancreatic beta cells represses UCP2 and improves glucose tolerance on a high-fat diet.

en-US.title: NDUFA9
en-US.description: Accessory subunit of mitochondrial Complex I (39-kDa subunit) deacetylated by SIRT3; part of the OXPHOS machinery regulating cellular ATP levels.

en-US.title: SIRT1 BAC Mice
en-US.description: Bacterial-artificial-chromosome SIRT1 transgenic mouse model — SIRT1 gain-of-function increases energy efficiency and protects against high-fat-diet-induced type 2 diabetes.

en-US.title: LCAD
en-US.description: Long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase — mitochondrial beta-oxidation enzyme deacetylated and activated by SIRT3 during fasting; SIRT3 knockout accumulates fatty-acid oxidation intermediates with low ATP.

en-US.title: Staphylococcus aureus
en-US.description: Gram-positive bacterium that induces vital NETosis through TLR2/TLR4 and PAD4 and encodes virulence factors that modulate NET formation.

en-US.title: Candida albicans
en-US.description: Opportunistic fungal pathogen whose filamentous hyphae trigger neutrophil extracellular trap release through size sensing and complement receptor 3 recognition.

en-US.title: Azurophil Granule
en-US.description: Neutrophil primary granules that store serine proteases, myeloperoxidase and antimicrobial peptides mobilised during phagocytosis, degranulation and NETosis.

en-US.title: GSDMD-p30
en-US.description: N-terminal pore-forming fragment of gasdermin D generated by neutrophil elastase or caspase-4/11 cleavage during NETosis and pyroptosis.

en-US.title: Azurosome
en-US.description: Multiprotein complex in azurophil granules that sequesters neutrophil elastase with myeloperoxidase until ROS-driven dissociation releases elastase during NETosis.

en-US.title: GSDMD inhibitor
en-US.description: Pharmacological blockers of gasdermin D pore formation used to dissect NETosis and proposed as candidate therapeutics in NET-associated disease.

en-US.title: DNase I
en-US.description: Endonuclease that degrades the DNA scaffold of neutrophil extracellular traps, used experimentally to dismantle NETs and encoded by microbes as an evasion factor.

en-US.title: Escherichia coli
en-US.description: Gram-negative bacterium captured and killed by neutrophil extracellular traps and a target of GSDMD-p30 pores and NET-associated antimicrobial proteins.

en-US.title: Dectin-1
en-US.description: C-type lectin receptor that recognises fungal beta-glucan and gates the neutrophil size-sensing decision between phagocytosis and NETosis.

en-US.title: Complement Receptor 3
en-US.description: Beta-2 integrin that recognises fibronectin-immobilised fungal beta-glucan to trigger vital NETosis.

en-US.title: Autoimmune Vasculitis
en-US.description: Autoimmune inflammation of vessel walls associated with vital NETosis and proposed as a NET-associated disease target for GSDMD inhibitors.

en-US.title: Aspergillus fumigatus
en-US.description: Filamentous fungus well characterised to induce neutrophil extracellular trap release.

en-US.title: Ionophores
en-US.description: Calcium ionophores used to trigger NETosis by raising cytosolic calcium and activating PAD4.

en-US.title: Sivelestat
en-US.description: Selective small-molecule neutrophil elastase inhibitor used as a tool compound to probe elastase-dependent NETosis.

en-US.title: Streptococcus pyogenes
en-US.description: Group A Streptococcus that evades NET-dependent host defense through nucleases, MPO-release suppression and phagocytosis evasion.

en-US.title: Citrobacter rodentium
en-US.description: Gram-negative bacterium that accesses the neutrophil cytosol and triggers noncanonical NETosis through the noncanonical inflammasome.

en-US.title: Calprotectin
en-US.description: S100A8/S100A9 heterodimer and major antifungal component of neutrophil extracellular traps.

en-US.title: Shigella flexneri
en-US.description: Gram-negative bacterium whose infection of PAD4-deficient neutrophils abolishes histone citrullination, vital NETosis and bacterial killing.

en-US.title: Cathepsin G
en-US.description: Neutrophil serine protease stored in azurophil granules and carried on neutrophil extracellular traps.

en-US.title: Pseudomonas aeruginosa
en-US.description: Gram-negative bacterium whose nonmucoid and mucoid strains induce NETs with stimulus-dependent protein composition.

en-US.title: Rac2
en-US.description: Hematopoietic small GTPase required for NADPH oxidase function and ROS-dependent NET release in neutrophils.

en-US.title: Klebsiella pneumoniae
en-US.description: Gram-negative bacterium used as an in vivo challenge model in which neutrophil elastase deficiency prevents NET formation.

en-US.title: P-selectin
en-US.description: Platelet and endothelial adhesion molecule that mediates the platelet-neutrophil interaction required for LPS-triggered vital NETosis.

en-US.title: Bordetella pertussis
en-US.description: Gram-negative bacterium whose adenylate cyclase toxin suppresses the neutrophil ERK-dependent oxidative burst and thereby NETosis.

en-US.title: Proteinase 3
en-US.description: Neutrophil serine protease stored in azurophil granules and carried on neutrophil extracellular traps.

en-US.title: Plasmodium falciparum
en-US.description: Malaria parasite reported to induce neutrophil extracellular trap release.

en-US.title: Toxoplasma gondii
en-US.description: Apicomplexan parasite reported to induce NETosis and to be entrapped by neutrophil extracellular traps.

en-US.title: Lactotransferrin
en-US.description: Iron-binding glycoprotein of neutrophil granules and a component of neutrophil extracellular traps.

en-US.title: Siglec-10
en-US.description: Siglec-10 (SIGLEC10) is an inhibitory I-type lectin on macrophages and other leukocytes that recognizes sialylated — and via CD24, non-sialylated — "don't-eat-me" signals, dampening phagocytosis of viable healthy cells.

zh-TW.title: Siglec-10
zh-TW.description: Siglec-10（SIGLEC10）是巨噬細胞與其他白血球上的抑制性 I 型凝集素，辨識唾液酸化——以及經由 CD24 的非唾液酸化——「don't-eat-me」訊號，抑制對存活健康細胞的吞噬作用。

en-US.title: CD24
en-US.description: CD24 is a small GPI-anchored sialoprotein on developing hematopoietic and tumor cells that, in humans, binds Siglec-10 on macrophages as a potent "don't-eat-me" signal and is a cancer stem-cell marker.

zh-TW.title: CD24
zh-TW.description: CD24 是發育中造血細胞與腫瘤細胞上的一種小型 GPI 錨定唾液酸蛋白，在人類中結合巨噬細胞上的 Siglec-10 作為強效的「don't-eat-me」訊號，也是癌症幹細胞標記。

en-US.title: ITIM
en-US.description: Immunoreceptor tyrosine-based inhibitory motif (ITIM) — a cytoplasmic consensus sequence (S/I/V/LxYxxI/V/L) that, once phosphorylated, recruits SHP-1/SHP-2 phosphatases to deliver inhibitory signals in immune receptors.

zh-TW.title: ITIM
zh-TW.description: 免疫受體酪胺酸基礎抑制基序（ITIM）——一種細胞質共有序列（S/I/V/LxYxxI/V/L），一旦磷酸化，會招募 SHP-1/SHP-2 磷酸酶以在免疫受體中傳遞抑制性訊號。

en-US.title: Cellular Senescence
en-US.description: Cellular Senescence is a state of permanent cell cycle arrest triggered by DNA damage, oxidative stress, telomere erosion, or oncogene activation. Senescent cells secrete a pro-inflammatory SASP that drives aging and tissue dysfunction.

zh-TW.title: Cellular Senescence
zh-TW.description: 細胞衰老是由 DNA 損傷、氧化壓力、端粒耗損或致癌基因活化所觸發的永久性細胞週期停滯狀態。衰老細胞會分泌促發炎的 SASP，驅動老化與組織功能障礙。

en-US.title: p38 MAPK
en-US.description: p38 mitogen-activated protein kinase (p38 MAPK) is a signaling molecule that regulates TFEB by phosphorylating it at S211 (inhibitory) or S401 (activating) depending on the cellular context.

zh-TW.title: p38 MAPK
zh-TW.description: p38 促分裂原活化蛋白激酶（p38 MAPK）是一種訊號分子，依細胞情境在 S211（抑制性）或 S401（活化性）位點磷酸化 TFEB 以調控其功能。

en-US.title: 2-deoxy-D-glucose
en-US.description: 2-deoxy-D-glucose (2DG) is a glucose analog that inhibits glycolysis and triggers a mitohormetic ROS response, extending lifespan in model organisms.

zh-TW.title: 2-deoxy-D-glucose
zh-TW.description: 2-去氧-D-葡萄糖（2DG）是抑制糖解的葡萄糖類似物，會觸發粒線體毒物興奮效應的 ROS 反應，在模式生物中延長壽命。

en-US.title: Polymorphism
en-US.description: A DNA sequence variation present in a population at a frequency of roughly one percent or more, encompassing single-nucleotide variants, indels and repeat-length variants, and forming the substrate of GWAS and pharmacogenomics.

zh-TW.title: Polymorphism
zh-TW.description: 在族群中頻率約 1% 以上的 DNA 序列變異，涵蓋單核苷酸變異、插入缺失與重複長度變異，是 GWAS 與藥物基因體學的基礎。

en-US.title: GTPase
en-US.description: Superclass of guanine nucleotide-binding proteins that cycle between GTP- and GDP-bound states to convert receptor or mechanical input into cellular output, encompassing the Ras, Rho, Rab, Arf and dynamin families.

zh-TW.title: GTPase
zh-TW.description: 鳥嘌呤核苷酸結合蛋白超類，藉由 GTP 結合與 GDP 結合狀態間的循環，把受體或機械輸入轉為細胞輸出，涵蓋 Ras、Rho、Rab、Arf 與 dynamin 家族。

en-US.title: Mast Cells
en-US.description: Connective-tissue granulocyte that senses allergens and pathogens through Fc-epsilonRI and Toll-like receptors, releasing histamine, proteases and lipid mediators that drive anaphylaxis and shape tissue inflammation.

zh-TW.title: Mast Cells
zh-TW.description: 結締組織中的顆粒性白血球，透過 Fc-epsilonRI 與 Toll 樣受體感知過敏原與病原，釋放組織胺、蛋白酶與脂質介質，驅動過敏性休克並塑造組織發炎。

en-US.title: Mycobacterium tuberculosis
en-US.description: The acid-fast, lipid-rich bacterium that causes tuberculosis, surviving inside macrophages by blocking phagosome-lysosome fusion, and driving caseating granuloma formation, latent infection and antibiotic-resistant disease.

zh-TW.title: Mycobacterium tuberculosis
zh-TW.description: 引起結核病的抗酸性、富含脂質分枝桿菌，藉阻斷吞噬體—溶體融合在巨噬細胞記憶存活，並導致乾酪性肉芽腫、潛伏感染與抗藥性疾病。

en-US.title: Osteoblast
en-US.description: Bone-forming mesenchymal cell that lays down osteoid and controls mineralisation, differentiated by Runx2 and osterix under Wnt/β-catenin signalling and coupled in a remodelling balance with the osteoclast.

zh-TW.title: Osteoblast
zh-TW.description: 由間質幹細胞而來、分泌類骨質並控制礦化的造骨細胞，受 Runx2 與 osterix 及 Wnt/β-catenin 訊號驅動分化，並與破骨細胞在重塑中耦聯。

en-US.title: Phagolysosome
en-US.description: Acidic hybrid compartment produced by fusion of a phagosome with a lysosome, where NADPH-oxidase-derived ROS and lysosomal cathepsins kill engulfed microbes and process antigen for MHC class II presentation.

zh-TW.title: Phagolysosome
zh-TW.description: 吞噬體與溶體融合形成的酸性雜交胞器，以 NADPH 氧化酶產生的 ROS 與溶體組織蛋白酶殺死吞噬的微生物，並處理抗原供 MHC 第二類呈現。

en-US.title: Nucleophagy
en-US.description: Selective autophagy of nuclear components, in which outer-membrane receptors such as NIX/BNIP3 and FUNDC1 deliver portions of the nuclear envelope and nucleoplasm to autophagosomes for lysosomal degradation.

zh-TW.title: Nucleophagy
zh-TW.description: 針對核成分的選擇性自噬，由 NIX/BNIP3、FUNDC1 等外膜受體把核被膜與核質部分送入自噬體進行溶體降解。

en-US.title: CD38
en-US.description: CD38 is an ectoenzyme that degrades NAD+ and its precursors like NMN, with its levels and activity increasing during aging and contributing to mitochondrial dysfunction. Also regulates extracellular NMN availability and is neuroprotective in axon injury models.

zh-TW.title: CD38
zh-TW.description: CD38 是一種降解 NAD+ 及其前驅物（如 NMN）的胞外酵素，其濃度與活性隨老化上升，並促成粒線體功能失調。它同時調控胞外 NMN 的可用性，並在軸突損傷模型中具有神經保護作用。

en-US.title: Serum Amyloid A
en-US.description: Hepatically derived acute-phase apolipoprotein (SAA1/SAA2) induced by IL-6 and IL-1 that promotes cholesterol transport and, when chronically elevated, forms amyloid fibrils causing AA amyloidosis.

zh-TW.title: Serum Amyloid A
zh-TW.description: 由 IL-6 與 IL-1 誘導、肝臟來源的急性期載脂蛋白（SAA1/SAA2），促進膽固醇運送，長期升高則形成類澱粉纖維導致 AA 類澱粉沉積症。

en-US.title: Kinetochore
en-US.description: Multimeric protein complex assembled on centromeric chromatin that captures spindle microtubules, generates and senses attachment tension, and houses the spindle assembly checkpoint that guards chromosome segregation.

zh-TW.title: Kinetochore
zh-TW.description: 組裝於著絲點染色質上的多聚蛋白複合體，負責捕捉紡錘體微管、產生並感知附著張力，並承載守護染色體分配的紡錘體組裝檢查點。

en-US.title: Skp2
en-US.description: F-box component of the SCF ubiquitin ligase that binds phosphorylated CDK inhibitors p27 and p21, represses the FoxO transcription factors and p53, and thereby promotes cell-cycle progression and senescence bypass.

zh-TW.title: Skp2
zh-TW.description: SCF 泛素連接酶的 F-box 次單元，可結合被磷酸化的 CDK 抑制物 p27 與 p21、抑制 FoxO 轉錄因子與 p53，藉以促進細胞週期進程並繞過細胞老化。

en-US.title: Lipolysis
en-US.description: Lipolysis is the hormone-gated hydrolysis of stored triacylglycerol to free fatty acids and glycerol by the ATGL-HSL-MGL cascade, and is the principal flux pathway for adipose energy release.

zh-TW.title: Lipolysis
zh-TW.description: 脂解（lipolysis）是由 ATGL-HSL-MGL 級聯把儲存的三酸甘油酯水解為游離脂肪酸與甘油的荷爾蒙門控過程，為脂肪組織釋放能量的主要通路。

en-US.title: Cdc42
en-US.description: Small Rho-family GTPase that organises cell polarity, filopodia and membrane ruffles, activates WAVE and PAK effectors, and recruits p67phox to assemble the NADPH oxidase.

zh-TW.title: Cdc42
zh-TW.description: 小型 Rho 家族 GTPase，組織細胞極性、絲狀偽足與膜皺褶，活化 WAVE 與 PAK 效應子，並招募 p67phox 組裝 NADPH 氧化酶。

en-US.title: Phosphatidylserine
en-US.description: Phosphatidylserine is an anionic aminophospholipid confined to the inner leaflet of the plasma membrane in healthy cells; its exposure on the outer leaflet is a universal "eat-me" signal that drives efferocytosis, and it is also the required negative charge for membrane curvature and for Ca2+-dependent clotting complex assembly.

zh-TW.title: Phosphatidylserine
zh-TW.description: 磷脂醯絲胺酸是陰離子性胺基磷脂，在健康細胞中侷限於質膜內葉；其外露於外葉是驅動胞葬作用的通用「eat-me」訊號，同時也是膜彎曲與 Ca2+ 依賴性凝血複合體組裝所必需的負電荷。

en-US.title: Dynamin
en-US.description: Large membrane-remodelling GTPase that polymerises into collars around necked membranes to drive clathrin-mediated endocytosis and synaptic vesicle scission through GTP hydrolysis.

zh-TW.title: Dynamin
zh-TW.description: 大型膜重塑 GTPase，聚合成環狀套筒環繞膜頸，透過水解 GTP 驅動網格蛋白媒介的胞吞作用與突觸囊泡剪切。

en-US.title: c-Rel
en-US.description: NF-kappaB family transcription factor that forms p50/c-Rel and p52/RelB dimers with distinct roles in inflammatory, survival and immune tolerance signalling and is oncogenic in lymphoma.

zh-TW.title: c-Rel
zh-TW.description: NF-kappaB 家族轉錄因子，形成 p50/c-Rel 與 p52/RelB 二聚體，在發炎、存活與免疫耐受訊號傳遞中扮演不同角色，並在淋巴瘤中具致癌性。

en-US.title: Triglycerides
en-US.description: Triacylglycerols are the dominant dietary and storage lipid, carried by chylomicrons and VLDL, mobilised by lipolysis, and their plasma elevation is a driver of pancreatitis and metabolic disease.

zh-TW.title: Triglycerides
zh-TW.description: 三酸甘油酯是膳食與儲存脂質的主體，由乳糜微粒與 VLDL 運送、經脂解動員，血中升高會驅動胰臟炎與代謝疾病。

en-US.title: Coactivator
en-US.description: Transcriptional coactivators such as p300/CBP, PGC-1alpha and the SRC/p160 family translate signalling inputs into chromatin opening and transcriptional output, and are held in check by NAD+-dependent sirtuins and HDACs.

zh-TW.title: Coactivator
zh-TW.description: p300/CBP、PGC-1alpha 與 SRC/p160 家族等轉錄共活化因子把訊號輸入轉譯為染色質開放與轉錄輸出，並受 NAD+ 依賴性 sirtuins 與 HDAC 抑制。

en-US.title: TLR7
en-US.description: Endosomal Toll-like receptor 7 that senses single-stranded RNA in endolysosomal compartments and drives type I interferon and NF-kappaB inflammatory signalling in plasmacytoid dendritic cells and B cells.

zh-TW.title: TLR7
zh-TW.description: 內體 Toll-like receptor 7，在內溶酶體區室偵測單股 RNA，驅動漿細胞樣樹突細胞與 B 細胞中的第一型干擾素及 NF-kappaB 發炎訊號。

en-US.title: Semicarbazide-Sensitive Amine Oxidase
en-US.description: Copper-dependent vascular amine oxidase SSAO (VAP-1) on endothelial and inflammatory cells that oxidizes primary amines to aldehydes, generating hydrogen peroxide and linking collagen cross-linking to diabetic vascular disease and inflammation.

zh-TW.title: Semicarbazide-Sensitive Amine Oxidase
zh-TW.description: 銅依賴的血管胺氧化酶 SSAO（VAP-1），位於內皮與發炎細胞表面，將一級胺氧化為醛並產生過氧化氫，把膠原交聯與糖尿病血管病變及發炎連結起來。

en-US.title: uPA/uPAR
en-US.description: The urokinase plasminogen activator and its GPI-anchored receptor CD87, which together localize plasmin generation to the cell surface and drive fibrinolysis, matrix remodelling, migration and the lysosomal-transcription signalling axis.

zh-TW.title: uPA/uPAR
zh-TW.description: 尿激酶型纖溶酶原活化因子與其 GPI 錨定受體 CD87，共同把纖溶酶生成局限於細胞表面，驅動纖溶、基質重塑、遷移與溶小體—轉錄訊息軸。

en-US.title: Bromodomain
en-US.description: Bromodomains are ~110-residue acetyl-lysine reader modules that translate histone acetylation into recruitment of transcriptional machinery, forming the reader tier of the writer-reader-eraser system alongside BET family proteins such as BRD2/3/4.

zh-TW.title: Bromodomain
zh-TW.description: Bromodomains 是約 110 個殘基的乙醯離胺酸讀取模組，把組蛋白乙醯化轉為轉錄機器的招募，與 BRD2/3/4 等 BET 家族蛋白共同構成書寫—讀取—擦除系統的讀取層。

en-US.title: Demyelination
en-US.description: Loss or dysfunction of myelin sheaths in the central or peripheral nervous system, producing slowed conduction, conduction block and secondary axonal degeneration in demyelinating disease.

zh-TW.title: Demyelination
zh-TW.description: 中樞或周邊神經系統髓鞘的喪失或功能障礙，在脫髓鞘疾病中造成傳導變慢、傳導阻斷與續發性軸突變性。

en-US.title: von Willebrand Factor
en-US.description: Multimeric endothelial and platelet adhesion protein that binds platelet GPIb under shear to anchor primary haemostasis and carries and stabilizes factor VIII, with quantitative and qualitative variants causing von Willebrand disease.

zh-TW.title: von Willebrand Factor
zh-TW.description: 多聚體性內皮與血小板黏附蛋白，在高剪應力下結合血小板 GPIb 錨定初期止血，並攜帶穩定第八凝血因子；量或質的變異造成 von Willebrand 氏病。

en-US.title: Prophase I
en-US.description: The extended meiotic prophase comprising leptotene, zygotene, pachytene, diplotene and diakinesis, during which homologous chromosomes pair, synapse, recombine, and undergo programmed genome surveillance before the first meiotic division.

zh-TW.title: Prophase I
zh-TW.description: 減數分裂前期 I 是減數分裂漫長的第一階段，包含細線期、合線期、粗線期、雙線期與終變期，同源染色體於此配對、聯會、重組並接受基因體監控。

en-US.title: Tissue Factor
en-US.description: Factor III, the transmembrane initiator of the extrinsic coagulation cascade that binds factor VIIa to trigger thrombin generation and, on monocytes and tumour cells, links coagulation to inflammation and cancer.

zh-TW.title: Tissue Factor
zh-TW.description: Factor III，外在凝血級聯的跨膜啟動者，結合 factor VIIa 觸發凝血酶生成，並在單核球與腫瘤細胞上把凝血與發炎及癌症相連。

en-US.title: Verapamil
en-US.description: Phenylalkylamine class IV antiarrhythmic and L-type calcium channel blocker used for supraventricular arrhythmia and hypertension that also inhibits P-glycoprotein and perturbs mitochondrial calcium handling.

zh-TW.title: Verapamil
zh-TW.description: 苯烷胺類第四類抗心律不整藥與 L 型鈣通道阻斷劑，用於上心室性心律不整與高血壓，同時抑制 P-醣蛋白並干擾粒線體鈣處理。

en-US.title: Resistance Training
en-US.description: Weight-bearing, high-load exercise that builds muscle strength and mass, raises insulin sensitivity, and engages mTOR/AMPK, myokines and mitochondrial biogenesis — a core lever for healthy ageing.

zh-TW.title: Resistance Training
zh-TW.description: 負重、高負荷的運動，可增進肌肉力量與質量、提升胰島素敏感性，並活化 mTOR/AMPK、肌肉細胞因子與粒線體生合成——健康老化的核心槓桿。

en-US.title: Acetylcholine
en-US.description: The neurotransmitter and paracrine signalling molecule acting at muscarinic M1-M5 and nicotinic acetylcholine receptors, central to cholinergic anti-inflammatory reflexes, vagal tone and metabolic regulation.

zh-TW.title: Acetylcholine
zh-TW.description: 作用於毒蕈鹼型 M1-M5 與菸鹼型乙醯膽鹼受體的神經傳訊物質與旁分泌訊號分子，在膽鹼能抗發炎反射、迷走神經張力與代謝調控中居於核心地位。

en-US.title: M-CSF
en-US.description: Macrophage colony-stimulating factor (CSF-1) cytokine that binds CSF1R to drive monocyte and macrophage differentiation, microglial maintenance and tumour-associated macrophage polarisation.

zh-TW.title: M-CSF
zh-TW.description: 巨噬細胞群落刺激因子（CSF-1），結合 CSF1R 驅動單核球與巨噬細胞分化、微膠細胞維持及腫瘤相關巨噬細胞極化。

en-US.title: HDL3
en-US.description: HDL3 is the small, dense, discoidal HDL subfraction that accepts cellular cholesterol via ABCA1 and matures into HDL2 through LCAT-driven cholesteryl ester formation.

zh-TW.title: HDL3
zh-TW.description: HDL3 是小型、緻密、盤狀的高密度脂蛋白次分群，經 ABCA1 接受細胞膽固醇，並透過 LCAT 生成膽固醇酯成熟為 HDL2。

en-US.title: Hypokalemia
en-US.description: Serum potassium below 3.5 mmol/L, caused by gastrointestinal and renal potassium loss, aldosterone excess, drugs and alkalosis, producing neuromuscular weakness and cardiac arrhythmia.

zh-TW.title: Hypokalemia
zh-TW.description: 血清鉀低於 3.5 mmol/L 的狀態，源於胃腸與腎臟鉀流失、醛固酮過多、藥物與鹼中毒，造成神經肌肉無力與心律不整。

en-US.title: PEGylation
en-US.description: Covalent attachment of polyethylene glycol chains to a protein, peptide or lipid surface, used to extend circulating half-life, reduce immunogenicity and improve solubility and pharmacokinetics of therapeutic agents.

zh-TW.title: PEGylation
zh-TW.description: 將聚乙二醇鏈共價結合至蛋白質、胜肽或脂質表面，用以延長循環半衰期、降低免疫原性，並改善治療劑的溶解度與藥物動力學性質。

en-US.title: PRDX1
en-US.description: PRDX1 (peroxiredoxin-1) is a thioredoxin-dependent peroxidase with a catalytic cysteine that acts as a fast H2O2 scavenger, a redox sensor, and a holdase chaperone, and it constrains ferroptosis by limiting lipid hydroperoxide accumulation.

zh-TW.title: PRDX1
zh-TW.description: PRDX1（peroxiredoxin-1）是硫氧還蛋白依賴性過氧化物酶，具催化性半胱胺酸，作為快速 H2O2 清除劑、氧化還原感受器與 holdase 伴侶蛋白，並藉限制脂質氫過氧化物累積而抑制鐵凋亡。

en-US.title: Cystic Fibrosis
en-US.description: Autosomal recessive disease caused by CFTR channel dysfunction, producing thick airway mucus, chronic Pseudomonas infection, pancreatic insufficiency and progressive bronchiectasis, and now treatable with CFTR modulators.

zh-TW.title: Cystic Fibrosis
zh-TW.description: 自體隱性疾病，因 CFTR 通道功能失常造成濃稠氣道黏液、慢性 Pseudomonas 感染、胰臟功能不足與進行性支氣管擴張，現可用 CFTR 調節劑治療。

en-US.title: Endothelium-Dependent Dilation
en-US.description: Flow-mediated vasodilation mediated by endothelial NO, prostacyclin and EDHF — the standard test of endothelial function, and one of the earliest measurable signs of vascular ageing and cardiovascular risk.

zh-TW.title: Endothelium-Dependent Dilation
zh-TW.description: 由內皮 NO、前列環素與 EDHF 介導的血流介導血管擴張——內皮功能的標準檢測，也是血管老化與心血管風險最早可測得的徵象之一。

en-US.title: SREBP
en-US.description: Sterol regulatory element-binding proteins — the SREBP1/SREBP2 family of ER-anchored basic helix-loop-helix transcription factors whose proteolytic processing controls cholesterol synthesis (SREBP-2) and fatty-acid/lipogenesis (SREBP-1c).

zh-TW.title: SREBP
zh-TW.description: 固醇調節元素結合蛋白——SREBP1/SREBP2 家族，錨定於內質網的 basic helix-loop-helix 轉錄因子，其蛋白水解除裂過程控制膽固醇合成（SREBP-2）與脂肪酸／脂質生成（SREBP-1c）。

en-US.title: DcR2
en-US.description: DcR2 (TRAIL-R4/TNFRSF10D) is a TNF-superfamily decoy receptor that binds TRAIL without a functional death domain, modulating TRAIL-induced apoptosis and representing a target for combination strategies that block decoy receptors.

zh-TW.title: DcR2
zh-TW.description: DcR2（TRAIL-R4/TNFRSF10D）是 TNF 超家族誘餌受體，結合 TRAIL 但缺乏功能性死亡結構域，調節 TRAIL 誘發的細胞凋亡，並作為阻斷誘餌受體之合併策略的標的。

en-US.title: Ferroptosis
en-US.description: Ferroptosis is a non-apoptotic form of regulated cell death driven by iron-dependent Lipid Peroxidation.

zh-TW.title: Ferroptosis
zh-TW.description: 鐵死亡是一種由鐵依賴性脂質過氧化所驅動的非凋亡型受調控細胞死亡形式。

en-US.title: DcR1
en-US.description: DcR1 (TRAIL-R3/TNFRSF10C) is a TNF-superfamily decoy receptor that sequesters TRAIL without a functional death domain, sparing normal cells and contributing to tumour resistance to TRAIL-based therapies.

zh-TW.title: DcR1
zh-TW.description: DcR1（TRAIL-R3/TNFRSF10C）是 TNF 超家族誘餌受體，在缺乏功能性死亡結構域的情況下隔離 TRAIL，使正常細胞免於凋亡，並促成腫瘤對 TRAIL 療法的抗性。

en-US.title: Osteoprotegerin
en-US.description: OPG (TNFRSF11B) — a soluble decoy receptor for RANKL that restrains osteoclastogenesis and bone resorption, with roles in osteoporosis, vascular calcification and tumour-bone interaction.

zh-TW.title: Osteoprotegerin（骨保護素）
zh-TW.description: OPG（TNFRSF11B）——RANKL 的可溶性誘餌受體，能抑制破骨細胞生成與骨質再吸收，並參與骨質疏鬆症、血管鈣化與腫瘤—骨交互作用。

en-US.title: Oxaliplatin
en-US.description: Oxaliplatin is a third-generation platinum (1R,2R-cyclohexane-1,2-diamine) complex that forms bulky intra- and interstrand DNA crosslinks, the backbone of chemotherapy in colorectal cancer, with cumulative peripheral neuropathy as its signature toxicity.

zh-TW.title: Oxaliplatin
zh-TW.description: Oxaliplatin 是第三代鉑類（1R,2R-環己烷-1,2-二胺）複合物，會形成龐大的鏈內與鏈間 DNA 交聯，是大腸直腸癌化療的骨幹，其特徵性毒性為累積性周邊神經病變。

en-US.title: TNFR2
en-US.description: TNFRSF1B (CD120b) — the TNF receptor 2, a death-domain-less TNFR1 paralog that signals through NF-κB via TRAF2/PI3K-Akt, modulates TNF bioavailability through soluble shedding, and is absent from mature erythrocytes.

zh-TW.title: TNFR2
zh-TW.description: TNFRSF1B（CD120b）——腫瘤壞死因子受體 2，為不帶死亡結構域的 TNFR1 旁系同源蛋白，經 TRAF2/PI3K-Akt 與 NF-κB 傳訊，並透過可溶性外域脫落調節 TNF 生物可用性；成熟紅血球不表現此受體。

en-US.title: Reactive Nitrogen Species
en-US.description: Reactive Nitrogen Species (RNS) are a family of antimicrobial molecules derived from Nitric Oxide (•NO) and superoxide (O2•−) produced via the enzymatic activity of inducible Nitric Oxide Synthase ...

zh-TW.title: Reactive Nitrogen Species（活性氮物種）
zh-TW.description: 活性氮物種（RNS）是由一氧化氮（•NO）與超氧化物（O2•−）衍生、經誘導型一氧化氮合成酶與 NADPH 氧化酶酵素活性產生的一族抗菌分子。

en-US.title: Small Humanin-Like Peptides
en-US.description: SHLPs — a family of short peptides derived from the mitochondrial open-reading frame of MTRNR2L (Humanin), with proposed mitochondrial and endocrine signalling roles in ageing and metabolism.

zh-TW.title: Small Humanin-Like Peptides（小型 Humanin 樣胜肽）
zh-TW.description: SHLPs——源自粒線體 MTRNR2L（Humanin）開放讀碼框的一族短胜肽，被推斷在老化與代謝中具有粒線體與內分泌訊號角色。

en-US.title: FADD
en-US.description: FADD (Fas-associated via death domain) is a critical adaptor protein that bridges death receptors to initiator caspases in the Extrinsic Pathway of Apoptosis.

zh-TW.title: FADD
zh-TW.description: FADD（Fas-associated via death domain）是關鍵的銜接蛋白，在凋亡的外在途徑中將死亡受體連結至起始型 caspase。

en-US.title: 1-Methylguanine
en-US.description: M1dG — the exocyclic guanine adduct formed by lipid peroxidation, a marker of oxidative DNA damage that is repaired by ALKBH2 and OGG1 and whose urinary levels track inflammation and lipid oxidation.

zh-TW.title: 1-Methylguanine（1-甲基鳥嘌呤）
zh-TW.description: M1dG——由脂質過氧化形成的鳥嘌呤環外加合物，是氧化性 DNA 損傷的標記，由 ALKBH2 與 OGG1 修復，其尿液含量追蹤發炎與脂質氧化。

en-US.title: NMN (Nicotinamide Mononucleotide)
en-US.description: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) is an endogenous nucleotide derived from vitamin B3 (niacin) and a direct biosynthetic precursor to NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide). NMN serves as a key i...

zh-TW.title: NMN (Nicotinamide Mononucleotide)
zh-TW.description: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）是源自維生素 B3（菸酸）的內源性核苷酸，也是 NAD+（菸鹼醯胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸）的直接生合成前驅物。NMN 是 NAD+ 補救路徑的關鍵中間產物。

en-US.title: cGMP-Dependent Protein Kinase I
en-US.description: cGMP-dependent protein kinase type I (cGKI, PRKG1) is the principal cGMP effector in erythrocytes; its loss raises cytosolic Ca2+, collapses phosphatidylserine asymmetry and drives eryptosis, causing anemia and splenomegaly in knockout mice.

zh-TW.title: cGMP-Dependent Protein Kinase I
zh-TW.description: cGMP 依賴性蛋白激酶 I 型（cGKI、PRKG1）是紅血球中主要的 cGMP 效應器；其缺失會提高細胞質 Ca2+、瓦解磷脂醯絲胺酸不對稱並驅動 eryptosis，使基因剔除小鼠出現貧血與脾腫大。

en-US.title: Sphingomyelin
en-US.description: A phosphosphingolipid synthesized from ceramide; a structural component of membranes and a reservoir for ceramide generation via sphingomyelinases.

zh-TW.title: Sphingomyelin
zh-TW.description: 由神經醯胺合成的磷酸鞘脂；膜的結構成分，也是經鞘磷脂酶產生神經醯胺的儲備池。

en-US.title: Fas
en-US.description: Fas (CD95/APO-1/FasR/TNFRSF6) is a TNF-superfamily death receptor that assembles the DISC with FADD and Caspase-8 to trigger extrinsic apoptosis, and whose blockade of Caspase-8 diverts signaling into RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL necroptosis.

zh-TW.title: Fas
zh-TW.description: Fas（CD95／APO-1／FasR／TNFRSF6）是 TNF 超家族死亡受體，與 FADD 及 Caspase-8 組裝 DISC 以啟動外在凋亡；當 Caspase-8 被阻斷時，訊號轉向 RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL 壞死性凋亡。

en-US.title: Sphingomyelinase
en-US.description: Sphingomyelinases are the sphingomyelin-hydrolyzing enzymes that generate ceramide; the acid form acts in lysosomes and secretory vesicles, the neutral forms (SMPD2/3) act at pH 7 in Golgi, ER and mitochondria, and both feed ceramide-dependent death signalling.

zh-TW.title: Sphingomyelinase
zh-TW.description: 鞘磷脂酶是水解鞘磷脂以產生神經醯胺的酵素家族；酸性型作用於溶酶體與分泌囊泡，中性型（SMPD2/3）在 pH 7 作用於高基氏體、內質網與粒線體，兩者皆供應神經醯胺依賴的死亡訊號。

en-US.title: DR5
en-US.description: TRAIL-R2 (TNFRSF10B, CD262) — the second functional TRAIL death receptor, a death-domain-containing TNF-superfamily receptor that signals through FADD/caspase-8 to apoptosis or, when caspase-8 is blocked, RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL necroptosis.

zh-TW.title: DR5
zh-TW.description: TRAIL-R2（TNFRSF10B、CD262）——第二個具功能的 TRAIL 死亡受體，屬含死亡結構域的 TNF 超家族受體，經 FADD/caspase-8 走向凋亡；當 caspase-8 被阻斷時，則轉為 RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL 壞死性凋亡。

en-US.title: CK1α
en-US.description: Casein kinase 1α (CK1α, CSNK1A1) is the erythrocyte-expressed CK1 isoform that acts pro-eryptotic by raising cytosolic Ca2+; activation enhances PS exposure, inhibition blunts stress-induced eryptosis.

zh-TW.title: CK1α
zh-TW.description: 酪蛋白激酶 1α（CK1α、CSNK1A1）是紅血球表現的 CK1 異構型，藉由提高細胞質 Ca2+ 而具促 eryptosis 作用；活化會增強 PS 外露，抑制則減弱壓力誘發的 eryptosis。

en-US.title: cADPR (Cyclic ADP-ribose)
en-US.description: Cyclic ADP-ribose (cADPR) is a novel cyclic nucleotide second messenger synthesized from NAD+ by ADP-ribosyl cyclases, primarily CD38 in mammals.

zh-TW.title: cADPR (Cyclic ADP-ribose)
zh-TW.description: 環腺苷二磷酸核糖（cADPR）是一種新型的環狀核苷酸第二訊使，由 ADP-核糖基環化酶自 NAD+ 合成；在哺乳類中主要由 CD38 負責。

en-US.title: Plasmalogen
en-US.description: Ether phospholipid containing a vinyl ether bond at the sn-1 position that protects membranes against oxidative damage, serves as a platelet-activating factor reservoir, and is enriched in brain, heart and mitochondrial membranes.

zh-TW.title: Plasmalogen
zh-TW.description: sn-1 位置帶乙烯醚鍵的醚磷脂，可保護膜免受氧化傷害、作為血小板活化因子儲庫，並富集於腦、心臟與粒線體膜。

en-US.title: Separase
en-US.description: Cysteine protease that cleaves cohesin at the onset of anaphase, releasing sister chromatids so that each can migrate to a daughter cell; its activity is gated by APC/C-dependent destruction of securin.

zh-TW.title: Separase
zh-TW.description: 在後期（anaphase）開始時切割黏連蛋白、釋放姊妹染色單體使各自移向子細胞的半胱胺酸蛋白酶；其活性由 APC/C 依賴的 securin 降解所把關。

en-US.title: Temozolomide
en-US.description: Temozolomide (TMZ) is an orally bioavailable imidazotetrazine alkylating prodrug that yields MTIC and O6-methylguanine DNA adducts, and is the standard-of-care chemotherapeutic backbone of glioblastoma when combined with radiotherapy.

zh-TW.title: Temozolomide
zh-TW.description: 替莫唑胺（TMZ）是口服可用的咪唑并四氮烯類烷化前驅藥，會生成 MTIC 與 O6-甲基鳥嘌呤 DNA 加合物，是膠質母細胞瘤合併放射治療的標準化學治療骨幹。

en-US.title: DR4
en-US.description: TRAIL-R1 (TNFRSF10A, CD261) — the primary TRAIL death receptor, a death-domain-containing TNF-superfamily receptor that assembles the DISC to activate caspase-8 and, when caspase-8 is blocked, RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL necroptosis.

zh-TW.title: DR4
zh-TW.description: TRAIL-R1（TNFRSF10A、CD261）——主要的 TRAIL 死亡受體，屬含死亡結構域的 TNF 超家族受體，組裝 DISC 以活化 caspase-8；當 caspase-8 被阻斷時，則轉為 RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL 壞死性凋亡。

en-US.title: AMPK
en-US.description: AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) is a central metabolic sensor that plays a critical role in the Aging process by integrating energy status with epigenetic regulation. As organisms age, AMPK...

zh-TW.title: AMPK
zh-TW.description: AMP 活化蛋白激酶（AMPK）是中央代謝感測器，藉由整合能量狀態與表觀遺傳調節，在老化（Aging）過程中扮演關鍵角色。隨著生物體老化，AMPK 的活性與反應性通常會下降，進而促成老化的各項徵象，包括表觀遺傳改變、蛋白質恆定性喪失與粒線體功能障礙。

en-US.title: Succinate
en-US.description: The TCA-cycle intermediate (succinate/succinic acid) that links energy metabolism to signalling — SDH substrate, HIF-α stabiliser when SDH is inhibited, protein succination target and pro-inflammatory metabolite in myeloid cells.

zh-TW.title: Succinate
zh-TW.description: TCA 循環中間產物琥珀酸，是 SDH 的受質，在 SDH 受抑制時穩定 HIF-α，並為蛋白質琥珀酸化與髓系細胞發炎代謝物的來源。

en-US.title: Decoy Receptor
en-US.description: Soluble or membrane decoy receptors that bind death ligands without a functional death domain, sparing normal cells from apoptosis — the DcR1/DcR2 pair for TRAIL and osteoprotegerin for RANKL.

zh-TW.title: Decoy Receptor
zh-TW.description: 可溶性或膜性誘餌受體能結合死亡配體但缺乏功能性死亡結構域，使正常細胞免於凋亡——包括 TRAIL 的 DcR1/DcR2 與 RANKL 的骨保護素。

en-US.title: Oxidative Stress
en-US.description: A phenomenon caused by an imbalance between the production and accumulation of Reactive Oxygen Species (ROS) and a biological system's ability to detoxify them; plays dual roles in physiology (redox signaling, mitohormesis) and pathology (aging, atherosclerosis, neurodegeneration).

zh-TW.title: Oxidative Stress（氧化壓力）
zh-TW.description: 一種由活性氧（ROS）的生成與累積、以及生物系統將其解毒的能力之間失衡所造成的現象；在生理學（氧化還原訊號傳遞、粒線體毒物興奮效應）與病理學（老化、動脈粥狀硬化、神經退化）中扮演雙重角色。

en-US.title: NAD+
en-US.description: NAD+ (Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide) is a critical coenzyme found in every cell, essential for energy Metabolism and a vital signaling molecule. It serves as an obligatory co-substrate for all ...

zh-TW.title: NAD+
zh-TW.description: NAD+（菸醯胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸）是存在於每個細胞中的關鍵輔酶，對能量代謝不可或缺，也是重要的訊號分子；它作為所有 sirtuin 酵素的必需共同受質。

en-US.title: Urolithin A
en-US.description: Urolithin A is a postbiotic metabolite derived from ellagitannins (found in pomegranates and nuts) that has been shown to induce mitophagy and improve muscle function and longevity in various m...

zh-TW.title: Urolithin A
zh-TW.description: Urolithin A 是一種源自鞣花單寧（存在於石榴與堅果中）的後生元代謝物，已被證實能在多種模式中誘導粒線體自噬，並改善肌肉功能與長壽。

en-US.title: Erythronecroptosis
en-US.description: RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL-dependent regulated necrosis of mature erythrocytes — the lytic, hemolysis-like counterpart of eryptosis, triggered by Fas/FasL, CD59 ligation with pore formation, ROS, ceramide and AGEs, and mutually exclusive with eryptosis via caspase-8.

zh-TW.title: Erythronecroptosis
zh-TW.description: 由 RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL 介導的成熟紅血球受調控壞死——eryptosis 的裂解性、類溶血對應形式，由 Fas/FasL、CD59 聯結（伴隨孔洞形成）、ROS、神經醯胺與 AGEs 觸發，並經由 caspase-8 與 eryptosis 互斥。

en-US.title: Akt
en-US.description: Akt (also known as Protein Kinase B or PKB) is a serine/threonine-specific protein kinase that plays a key role in multiple cellular processes such as glucose metabolism, apoptosis, cell prolif...

zh-TW.title: Akt
zh-TW.description: Akt（又稱蛋白質激酶 B，PKB）是一種絲胺酸／蘇胺酸專一性蛋白質激酶，在葡萄糖代謝、凋亡、細胞增殖、轉錄與細胞遷移等多項細胞過程中扮演關鍵角色，也是 PI3K/Akt 訊息傳遞路徑中調控細胞存活、生長與代謝的核心節點。

en-US.title: Kupffer Cell
en-US.description: Hepatic macrophage of the liver sinusoids; the principal phagocyte clearing PS-exposing (eryptotic and senescent) erythrocytes and RBC-derived vesicles, forming erythrophagolysosomes and driving hepatic iron recycling.

zh-TW.title: Kupffer Cell
zh-TW.description: 肝血竇的肝臟巨噬細胞；清除 PS 外露（eryptotic 與衰老）紅血球與 RBC 衍生囊泡的主要吞噬細胞，形成 erythrophagolysosome 並驅動肝臟鐵回收。

en-US.title: RIPK3
en-US.description: Receptor-interacting serine/threonine-protein kinase 3 is the obligatory kinase of necroptosis, recruited by RIPK1 via RHIM-domain amyloid-like assembly and activated by phosphorylation of its own RIPK3 domain; it also drives pyroptosis through caspase-8 inhibition when necroptosis is blocked.

zh-TW.title: RIPK3
zh-TW.description: 受體交互作用型絲胺酸／蘇胺酸蛋白激酶 3 是壞死性凋亡的必需激酶，由 RIPK1 透過 RHIM 結構域的類澱粉狀組裝招募，並藉由其自身 RIPK3 結構域的磷酸化而活化；當壞死性凋亡被阻斷時，它也透過抑制 caspase-8 來驅動細胞焦亡。

en-US.title: Malaria
en-US.description: Plasmodium infection of erythrocytes; oxidative stress opens cation channels, eryptosis clears infected cells and parasites, eryptosis-lowering erythrocyte traits (G6PD deficiency, sickle trait, thalassemia) confer partial protection, and pro-eryptotic xenobiotics slow parasitemia.

zh-TW.title: Malaria（瘧疾）
zh-TW.description: 瘧原蟲感染紅血球；氧化壓力開啟陽離子通道，eryptosis 清除受感染細胞與寄生蟲，降低 eryptosis 的紅血球性狀（G6PD 缺乏、鐮刀型細胞性狀、地中海型貧血）提供部分保護，而促 eryptosis 的外來物質減緩寄生蟲血症。

en-US.title: Erythropoiesis
en-US.description: Bone-marrow production of red cells from hematopoietic stem cells through erythroid progenitors and reticulocytes, ending in enucleation and organelle clearance — the process whose terminal steps define which cell-death machinery mature erythrocytes retain.

zh-TW.title: Erythropoiesis（紅血球生成）
zh-TW.description: 骨髓從造血幹細胞經過紅血球前驅細胞與網狀紅血球製造紅血球，最終脫核並清除胞器——此過程的終端步驟決定成熟紅血球保留哪些細胞死亡機器。

en-US.title: NF-κB
en-US.description: Nuclear factor kappa-light-chain-enhancer of activated B cells (NF-κB) is a protein complex that controls transcription of DNA, cytokine production, and cell survival. It plays a central role in immunity, inflammation, and redox signaling.

zh-TW.title: NF-κB
zh-TW.description: 活化 B 細胞核因子 κ 輕鏈增強子（NF-κB）是控制 DNA 轉錄、胞激素生成與細胞存活的蛋白質複合體，在免疫、發炎與氧化還原訊號中扮演核心角色。

en-US.title: Hemopexin
en-US.description: Plasma heme-binding glycoprotein that scavenges heme released by hemoglobin breakdown, delivering it to CD91 receptors on hepatocytes and macrophages for HO-1-dependent recycling to bilirubin and iron; its depletion is a marker of intravascular hemolysis.

zh-TW.title: Hemopexin
zh-TW.description: 血漿中結合血基質的醣蛋白，會捕捉血紅素分解釋出的血基質，將其遞送至肝細胞與巨噬細胞上的 CD91 受體，供 HO-1 依賴的回收為膽紅素與鐵；其耗盡是血管內溶血的標記。

en-US.title: Calpain
en-US.description: Calpain is a Ca2+-dependent cysteine protease; calpain-1 mediates AIF release in parthanatos and routes Ca2+ signals through BID/BAX, and produces the membrane blebbing of erythrocyte eryptosis by digesting the membrane-cytoskeleton scaffold.

zh-TW.title: Calpain
zh-TW.description: Calpain 是一種 Ca2+ 依賴型半胱胺酸蛋白酶；calpain-1 在 parthanatos 中媒介 AIF 的釋放，並經由 BID/BAX 傳遞 Ca2+ 訊號，同時透過消化膜—細胞骨架支架而造成紅血球 eryptosis 的膜出芽。

en-US.title: Erythrocyte Senescence
en-US.description: The ~120-day aging program of mature red cells — surface/volume loss, density rise, reduced deformability, cation loss, desialylation, oxidative damage, hemichrome, reduced CD47, AE1 neo-antigen — cleared over days by macrophage/NOAb immunity, distinct from minutes-fast eryptosis.

zh-TW.title: Erythrocyte Senescence（紅血球衰老）
zh-TW.description: 成熟紅血球約 120 天的老化程式——表面積／體積喪失、密度上升、變形性降低、陽離子喪失、去唾液酸化、氧化損傷、hemichrome、CD47 減少、AE1 新抗原——由巨噬細胞／NOAb 免疫在數天內清除，與數分鐘內完成的 eryptosis 不同。

en-US.title: Lipid Peroxidation
en-US.description: The oxidative degradation of polyunsaturated fatty acids via a free radical chain reaction; a central execution pathway of oxidative stress that damages membranes, proteins, and DNA and drives atherosclerosis and ferroptosis.

zh-TW.title: 脂質過氧化
zh-TW.description: 多元不飽和脂肪酸經由自由基連鎖反應所進行的氧化降解；此為氧化壓力的核心執行途徑，會損傷細胞膜、蛋白質與 DNA，並驅動動脈粥狀硬化與鐵死亡。

en-US.title: Haptoglobin
en-US.description: Plasma glycoprotein that binds free hemoglobin released by hemolysis with high affinity, forming the haptoglobin-hemoglobin complex cleared via CD91 receptors; a front-line scavenger of intravascular hemolysis.

zh-TW.title: Haptoglobin
zh-TW.description: 血漿醣蛋白，以高度親和力結合溶血釋出的游離血紅蛋白，形成 haptoglobin-血紅蛋白複體並經由 CD91 受體清除；是血管內溶血的第一線清道夫。

en-US.title: Glutathione
en-US.description: Glutathione (GSH) is the most abundant endogenous thiol antioxidant, a tripeptide of glutamate, cysteine, and glycine that buffers cellular redox state, reduces peroxides via GPX enzymes, and conjugates electrophiles for excretion.

zh-TW.title: Glutathione
zh-TW.description: Glutathione（GSH）是含量最豐富的內源性硫醇抗氧化劑，為由麩胺酸、半胱胺酸與甘胺酸組成的三肽，能緩衝細胞氧化還原狀態、透過 GPX 酶還原過氧化物，並與親電子物質結合以排出體外。

en-US.title: Carbonic Anhydrase
en-US.description: Zinc enzyme catalyzing CO2 + H2O <-> H2CO3 <-> H+ + HCO3-; in erythrocytes it completes ~23% of CO2 carriage and pairs with anion exchanger 1 in the chloride shift that loads and unloads CO2 in tissues and lung.

zh-TW.title: Carbonic Anhydrase（碳酸酐酶）
zh-TW.description: 催化 CO2 + H2O ⇄ H2CO3 ⇄ H+ + HCO3− 的含鋅酵素；在紅血球中完成約 23% 的 CO2 運送，並與陰離子交換蛋白 1 配對，在組織與肺臟進行氯離子轉移以裝載與卸載 CO2。

en-US.title: NAFLD
en-US.description: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, the most common liver disease worldwide and the hepatic manifestation of metabolic syndrome; renamed MASLD in the 2023 multisociety Delphi consensus.

zh-TW.title: NAFLD
zh-TW.description: 非酒精性脂肪肝（NAFLD）是全球最常見的肝臟疾病，也是代謝症候群的肝臟表現；2023 年多學會 Delphi 共識將其重新命名為 MASLD。

en-US.title: TRPC6
en-US.description: Ca2+-permeable transient receptor potential channel 6; mediates Ca2+ influx into human erythrocytes (TRPC4/5 fill that role in mouse), one of the entry routes whose overload can trigger eryptosis.

zh-TW.title: TRPC6
zh-TW.description: 可通透 Ca2+ 的瞬時受體電位通道 6；在人類紅血球中介導 Ca2+ 內流（小鼠由 TRPC4/5 擔任該角色），是過載可觸發 eryptosis 的進入途徑之一。

en-US.title: Kidney Diseases
en-US.description: The umbrella of acute and chronic disorders of renal structure or function, dominated by diabetes and hypertension, defined by a sustained abnormality in filtration or structure lasting over three months, and the leading cause of cardiovascular morbidity and mortality worldwide.

zh-TW.title: Kidney Diseases
zh-TW.description: 腎臟疾病是腎臟構造或功能急性與慢性異常的總稱，以糖尿病與高血壓為主因，定義為濾過或構造上的持續性異常超過三個月，並是全球心血管疾病罹病與死亡的首要原因。

en-US.title: Chronic Inflammation
en-US.description: Sustained, non-resolving inflammatory signaling lasting weeks to years, driven by persisting triggers and defective resolution programs; it is a core mechanism of inflammaging, atherosclerosis, autoimmune disease, and inflammation-driven tumorigenesis.

zh-TW.title: 慢性發炎
zh-TW.description: 持續數週至數年、無法自行消退的發炎訊號傳遞，由持續存在的誘發因素與失效的消退程式所驅動；它是發炎性老化、動脈粥狀硬化、自體免疫疾病以及發炎驅動的腫瘤發生之核心機制。

en-US.title: Erythrocytes
en-US.description: Mature red blood cells — hemoglobin-filled, anucleate, organelle-free 7–8 µm biconcave cells whose only regulated death programs are eryptosis and erythronecroptosis, and which also govern NO bioavailability, hemostasis, redox balance and innate immunity.

zh-TW.title: Erythrocytes
zh-TW.description: 成熟紅血球——充滿血紅素、無核、無胞器、7–8 µm 的雙凹圓盤細胞，其僅存的受調控死亡程式為 eryptosis 與 erythronecroptosis，並同時主導一氧化氮生物可用性、凝血、氧化還原平衡與先天免疫。

en-US.title: Piezo1
en-US.description: Mechanosensitive nonselective cation channel; in erythrocytes it transduces mechanical stress into Ca2+ influx, linking shear/stretch (including from nanomaterials accumulating outside the cell) to eryptosis.

zh-TW.title: Piezo1
zh-TW.description: 機械敏感性非選擇性陽離子通道；在紅血球中將機械壓力轉換為 Ca2+ 內流，將剪應力／拉伸（包括細胞外累積的奈米材料）連結到 eryptosis。

en-US.title: TLR9
en-US.description: Endosomal Toll-like receptor that senses unmethylated CpG DNA and modulates cGAS expression in a context-dependent manner.

zh-TW.title: TLR9
zh-TW.description: 內體 Toll 樣受體，負責感受未甲基化的 CpG DNA，並以情境相依的方式調節 cGAS 的表現。

en-US.title: Duffy Antigen Receptor for Chemokines
en-US.description: DARC (ACKM1), the erythrocyte surface chemokine receptor that scavenges CXC and CC chemokines from plasma, fine-tuning immune cell trafficking and serving as the invasion receptor for Plasmodium vivax and P. knowlesi.

zh-TW.title: Duffy Antigen Receptor for Chemokines（Duffy 趨化因子受體）
zh-TW.description: DARC（ACKM1），紅血球表面的趨化因子受體，從血漿清除 CXC 與 CC 趨化因子，微調免疫細胞運輸，並作為 Plasmodium vivax 與 P. knowlesi 的入侵受體。

en-US.title: Receptor Tyrosine Kinases
en-US.description: Receptor tyrosine kinases (RTKs) are a family of 58 single-pass transmembrane receptors in 20 subfamilies that autophosphorylate on tyrosine after ligand-induced dimerization, generating phosphotyrosine docking sites that feed the MAPK PI3K-Akt and PLCγ pathways.

zh-TW.title: Receptor Tyrosine Kinases
zh-TW.description: 受體酪胺酸激酶（RTKs）是由 58 個受體構成、歸為 20 個亞家族的单次跨膜受體家族；它們在配體誘導二聚化後於酪胺酸上自體磷酸化，產生磷酸酪胺酸停泊位點，向 MAPK、PI3K-Akt 與 PLCγ 路徑傳遞訊號。

en-US.title: Reticulocyte
en-US.description: The immature, enucleated red cell released from bone marrow that still contains residual ribosomes and organelles; the stage at which mitochondria are cleared, and its circulating count is the standard readout of erythropoietic output in anemia.

zh-TW.title: Reticulocyte（網狀紅血球）
zh-TW.description: 從骨髓釋出的未成熟、已脫核紅血球，仍含有殘餘核糖體與胞器；是粒線體被清除的階段，其循環計數是貧血中紅血球生成輸出的標準讀數。

en-US.title: Angiotensin II Type 1 Receptor
en-US.description: The angiotensin II type 1 receptor (AT1R, gene AGTR1) is the principal G-protein-coupled receptor mediating the pressor, pro-inflammatory, and pro-fibrotic actions of angiotensin II, and the target of the angiotensin receptor blocker drug class.

zh-TW.title: 血管張力素 II 第一型受體
zh-TW.description: 血管張力素 II 第一型受體（AT1R，基因 AGTR1）是介導血管張力素 II 之升壓、促發炎與促纖維化作用的主要 G 蛋白偶聯受體，也是血管張力素受體阻斷劑這一藥物類別的標的。

en-US.title: Manganese Superoxide Dismutase (MnSOD/SOD2)
en-US.description: Manganese Superoxide Dismutase (MnSOD/SOD2) is the primary mitochondrial antioxidant enzyme responsible for dismutating Superoxide (O₂⁻) to hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) and oxygen. It is encoded by the SOD2 gene and imported into the mitochondrial matrix.

zh-TW.title: Manganese Superoxide Dismutase (MnSOD/SOD2)
zh-TW.description: Manganese Superoxide Dismutase（MnSOD/SOD2）是主要的粒線體抗氧化酵素，負責將超氧化物陰離子（O₂⁻）歧化為過氧化氫（H₂O₂）與氧氣。它由 SOD2 基因編碼，並被運送到粒線體基質中。

en-US.title: NLRP3
en-US.description: NOD-like receptor pyrin domain-containing protein 3 (NLRP3, cryopyrin), the sensor component of the NLRP3 inflammasome. It is a tripartite PYD-NACHT-LRR protein activated by a two-step priming-then-activation process that culminates in caspase-1 activation and pyroptosis.

zh-TW.title: NLRP3
zh-TW.description: NOD-like receptor pyrin domain-containing protein 3（NLRP3，cryopyrin），為 NLRP3 發炎小體的感測器成分。它是一個由 PYD-NACHT-LRR 三部分組成的蛋白，透過「先致敏（priming）、後活化」的兩步驟過程被活化，最終導致 caspase-1 活化與細胞焦亡（pyroptosis）。

en-US.title: IGF1R
en-US.description: IGF1R (CD221) is a ubiquitously expressed receptor tyrosine kinase of the insulin receptor family. It is a disulfide-linked alpha2beta2 tetramer that signals through IRS/Shc to PI3K-AKT-mTOR and RAS-MAPK, is obligatory for prenatal growth, and is a driver and validated-on-target-but-hard-to-drug cancer dependency.

zh-TW.title: IGF1R
zh-TW.description: IGF1R（CD221）是胰島素受體家族中廣泛表現的受體酪胺酸激酶。它是由雙硫鍵相連的 α2β2 四聚體，透過 IRS/ShC 訊號傳遞至 PI3K-AKT-mTOR 與 RAS-MAPK；為產前生長所必需，並且是癌症的驅動因子與已獲驗證為有效標的但難以成藥的依賴關係。

en-US.title: Scramblase
en-US.description: Calcium-activated phospholipid scramblases (TMEM16F/ANO6, PLSCR family) that externalize phosphatidylserine — the eat-me signal executed in eryptosis and apoptosis.

zh-TW.title: Scramblase
zh-TW.description: 鈣活化的磷脂 scramblase（TMEM16F/ANO6、PLSCR 家族），將磷脂醯絲胺酸外露——即 eryptosis 與凋亡所執行的「eat-me」訊號。

en-US.title: FASN
en-US.description: FASN is the human fatty acid synthase, a single 251 kDa multi-enzyme polypeptide that condenses one acetyl-CoA and seven malonyl-CoA plus 14 NADPH into palmitate, the committed enzyme of de novo lipogenesis.

zh-TW.title: FASN
zh-TW.description: FASN 是人類脂肪酸合成酶，一條 251 kDa 的多酵素多肽鏈，將一個乙醯輔酶 A、七個丙二醯輔酶 A 加上 14 個 NADPH 縮合為棕櫚酸，是從頭脂肪生成的承諾步驟酵素。

en-US.title: Parkin
en-US.description: An E3 ubiquitin ligase that plays a critical role in Mitophagy. It is recruited to damaged mitochondria by PINK1 and labels them for degradation by the lysosome.

zh-TW.title: Parkin
zh-TW.description: Parkin 是一種在粒線體自噬中扮演關鍵角色的 E3 泛素連接酶。它由 PINK1 招募至受損的粒線體，並將其標記以供溶酶體降解。

en-US.title: Antiphospholipid Syndrome
en-US.description: Autoimmune thrombophilia defined by antiphospholipid antibodies plus arterial/venous thrombosis or pregnancy morbidity; APS patient autoantibodies induce eryptosis in healthy red cells, offering a route to the prothrombotic erythrocyte phenotype.

zh-TW.title: Antiphospholipid Syndrome（抗磷脂症候群）
zh-TW.description: 由抗磷脂抗體加上動脈／靜脈血栓或妊娠罹病所定義的自體免疫性血栓形成傾向；APS 患者的自體抗體在健康紅血球中誘導 eryptosis，提供通往促血栓性紅血球表型的途徑。

en-US.title: Deep Vein Thrombosis
en-US.description: Deep vein thrombosis is clot formation in a deep vein, most often below the knee, arising where venous stasis, endothelial injury and hypercoagulability converge; it is the primary cause of pulmonary embolism and a major preventable cause of morbidity and mortality.

zh-TW.title: 深層靜脈栓塞
zh-TW.description: 深層靜脈栓塞是深層靜脈內的血栓形成，最常發生於膝下，起因於靜脈血流滯留、內皮損傷與高凝狀態三者交會之處；它是肺栓塞的首要原因，也是可預防之發病與死亡的主要原因。

en-US.title: Histone H2A
en-US.description: Histone H2A is one of the four canonical core histones, present as two copies per nucleosome octamer; it supplies the acidic patch on the nucleosome surface that most bromodomain and PHD finger readers bind, carries modification sites including H2AK119ub, and is the base protein from which H2A.Z, H2A.X, H2A.J and macroH2A variants are derived.

zh-TW.title: 組蛋白 H2A
zh-TW.description: 組蛋白 H2A 是四種典型核心組蛋白之一，每個核小體八聚體中含有兩份；它提供核小體表面的酸性斑塊，是多數溴結構域與 PHD 指狀閱讀器的結合位點，帶有包括 H2AK119ub 在內的修飾位點，也是 H2A.Z、H2A.X、H2A.J 與 macroH2A 等變異體的基礎蛋白質。

en-US.title: MET
en-US.description: MET is the gene encoding c-Met, the hepatocyte growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase, a proto-oncogene and therapeutic target in gastric, lung and liver cancers.

zh-TW.title: MET
zh-TW.description: MET 是編碼 c-Met 的基因，c-Met 即肝細胞生長因子受體酪胺酸激酶，是一個原致癌基因，同時也是胃癌、肺癌與肝癌的治療標的。

en-US.title: PINK1
en-US.description: Mitochondrial serine/threonine kinase that recruits Parkin to damaged mitochondria to initiate mitophagy.

zh-TW.title: PINK1
zh-TW.description: 招募 Parkin 至受損粒線體以啟動粒線體自噬的粒線體絲胺酸／蘇胺酸激酶。

en-US.title: Phagocytosis
en-US.description: Phagocytosis is the actin-driven engulfment of large particles by professional phagocytes, culminating in phagosome formation and fusion with lysosomes for degradation; specialised forms include efferocytosis, LC3-associated phagocytosis and LAP-independent corpse clearance.

zh-TW.title: 吞噬作用
zh-TW.description: 吞噬作用是專職吞噬細胞以肌動蛋白驅動、將大型顆粒吞入的過程，最終形成吞噬體並與溶酶體融合以進行降解；其專門形式包括凋亡細胞清除、LC3 相關吞噬作用，以及獨立於 LAP 的屍體清除。

en-US.title: Rac GTPase
en-US.description: The Rac GTPases (RAC1, RAC2, RAC3, RHOG) are a subfamily of Rho-family small GTPases of roughly 21-25 kDa. They act as binary GDP/GTP switches cycle nucleotide state via GEFs, GAPs and GDIs, and drive lamellipodia membrane ruffles and cell adhesion through WAVE, PAK and NADPH oxidase effectors.

zh-TW.title: Rac GTP酶
zh-TW.description: Rac GTP酶（RAC1、RAC2、RAC3、RHOG）是 Rho 家族小 GTP酶中約 21-25 kDa 的一個亞家族。它們以 GDP/GTP 二元開關運作，透過 GEF、GAP 與 GDI 循環核苷酸狀態，並經由 WAVE、PAK 與 NADPH 氧化酶等效應器驅動偽足、膜皺褶與細胞黏附。

en-US.title: Endometrial Cancer
en-US.description: Endometrial cancer is a malignancy of the uterine lining, most commonly endometrioid adenocarcinoma arising on a background of unopposed estrogen exposure; TCGA divides it into four molecular subgroups with sharply divergent prognosis.

zh-TW.title: 子宮內膜癌
zh-TW.description: 子宮內膜癌是子宮內襯的惡性腫瘤，最常見者為在無對抗性雌激素暴露背景下發生的類內膜腺癌；TCGA 將其分為四個預後截然不同的分子次群。

en-US.title: Radiotherapy
en-US.description: The therapeutic use of ionizing radiation to damage tumour DNA; the mechanism is indirect, via radiolysis of water and the resulting radical chemistry that fixes DNA damage, and the tumour kill is governed by the linear-quadratic cell survival relationship and the oxygen enhancement ratio.

zh-TW.title: Radiotherapy
zh-TW.description: 運用電離輻射損傷腫瘤 DNA 的治療方式；其機制是間接的，經由水的輻解與隨後的的自由基化學將 DNA 損傷「固定」下來，而腫瘤殺傷則由線性－平方細胞存活關係與氧增強比所決定。

en-US.title: Amyloid Beta
en-US.description: Amyloid beta (Aβ) is a 38–43 residue peptide shed from the transmembrane amyloid precursor protein by sequential beta- and gamma-secretase cleavage; its soluble oligomers impair synaptic plasticity and drive neurotoxicity in Alzheimer disease.

zh-TW.title: Amyloid Beta
zh-TW.description: 類澱粉β（Aβ）是由跨膜類澱粉前驅蛋白（amyloid precursor protein）經連續的 β- secretase 與 γ-secretase 切割所釋出的 38–43 殘基胜肽；其可溶性寡聚體會損害突觸可塑性，並在阿茲海默氏症中驅動神經毒性。

en-US.title: Myofibroblast
en-US.description: A contractile, activated fibroblast state characterised by alpha-smooth muscle actin stress fibres and increased matrix production, generated by TGF-beta signalling and responsible both for wound contraction and for the progressive matrix deposition of fibrosis.

zh-TW.title: 肌成纖維母細胞
zh-TW.description: 一種具收縮能力的活化纖維母細胞狀態，其特徵為α-平滑肌肌動蛋白應力纖維與增加的基質生成，由 TGF-beta 訊號傳遞產生，並同時負責傷口收縮與纖維化過程中逐步累積的基質沉積。

en-US.title: VMAT2
en-US.description: VMAT2 is the presynaptic vesicular monoamine transporter in monoaminergic neurons; it packages cytosolic dopamine, serotonin and noradrenaline into synaptic vesicles and is the pharmacological target of reserpine and the tetrabenazine-class VMAT2 inhibitors used in tardive dyskinesia.

zh-TW.title: VMAT2
zh-TW.description: VMAT2 是單胺能神經元突觸前的囊泡單胺轉運蛋白；它將細胞質中的多巴胺、血清素與正腎上腺胺包裝進突觸囊泡，並是利血平與用於遲發性運動障礙的丁苯那嗪類 VMAT2 抑制劑的藥理學標的。

en-US.title: Embryogenesis
en-US.description: The formation and early development of an embryo, from fertilisation through cleavage, gastrulation, neurulation and organogenesis. It is the period in which the three germ layers and body axes are established, and is the developmental window during which most birth defects and most spontaneous abortions originate.

zh-TW.title: Embryogenesis
zh-TW.description: 胚胎的形成與早期發育，涵蓋受精、卵裂、原腸胚形成、神經管形成與器官發育。這是三胚層與體軸建立的時期，也是大多數出生缺陷與大多數自發性流產的發育起源窗口。

en-US.title: Histone H2B
en-US.description: Histone H2B is one of the four canonical core histones, present as two copies per nucleosome octamer as the obligate partner of H2A; its best-known modification is K120 monoubiquitination, a co-transcriptional mark that is an obligate precursor to H3K4 and H3K79 methylation, and its C-terminal motif is a major docking site for FACT and TFIIS.

zh-TW.title: 組蛋白 H2B
zh-TW.description: 組蛋白 H2B 是四種典型核心組蛋白之一，每個核小體八聚體中存在兩份，擔任 H2A 不可或缺的搭檔；其最著名的修飾是 K120 單泛素化，一種共轉錄標記，也是 H3K4 與 H3K79 甲基化的必要前驅物，而其 C 端基序是 FACT 與 TFIIS 的重要停靠位點。

en-US.title: Long-Term Potentiation
en-US.description: Long-term potentiation (LTP) is a persistent, input-specific strengthening of synaptic transmission following brief high-frequency activity, widely treated as the leading cellular substrate for learning and memory.

zh-TW.title: 長期增益作用
zh-TW.description: 長期增益作用（LTP）是短暫高頻活動之後，突觸傳遞所產生的持續且具輸入專一性的增強，普遍被視為學習與記憶的主要細胞層級受質。

en-US.title: Necroptosis
en-US.description: Regulated necrotic cell death executed by the RIPK1-RIPK3-MLKL necrosome when caspase-8 is blocked; lytic and inflammatory, bridging cell death, innate immunity, and disease.

zh-TW.title: Necroptosis
zh-TW.description: 當 caspase-8 被阻斷時，由 RIPK1-RIPK3-MLKL 壞死小體執行的調控性壞死細胞死亡；具裂解性與發炎性，連結細胞死亡、先天免疫與疾病。

en-US.title: LC3B
en-US.description: Microtubule-associated protein 1B light chain 3 (MAP1LC3B), the most abundant mammalian ATG8-family protein. LC3B is lipidated to the inner autophagosomal membrane and acts as a membrane-bound binding platform for cargo receptors through LIR motif recognition; it is the standard biochemical marker of autophagic flux.

zh-TW.title: LC3B
zh-TW.description: 微管相關蛋白 1B 輕鏈 3（MAP1LC3B），為哺乳類中含量最豐富的 ATG8 家族蛋白。LC3B 會被脂質化至自噬體內膜，並透過 LIR 標記辨識，作為膜上結合貨受體的結合平台；它是自噬流量的標準生化標記。

en-US.title: Gaucher Disease
en-US.description: Gaucher disease is the most common lysosomal storage disorder, an autosomal recessive deficiency of lysosomal glucocerebrosidase that causes glucosylceramide accumulation in monocyte-macrophages, producing hepatosplenomegaly, cytopenias, bone disease and, in rare types, neurological involvement.

zh-TW.title: 高雪氏症
zh-TW.description: 高雪氏症是最常見的溶酶體儲積症，屬體染色體隱性的溶酶體葡萄糖腦苷脂酶缺乏症，造成葡萄糖神經醯胺在單核細胞—巨噬細胞中累積，導致肝脾腫大、血球減少、骨病變，少数類型則涉及神經系統。

en-US.title: ATG Genes
en-US.description: ATG genes encode the core autophagy machinery first identified in yeast and named Apg/Nir/Atg; the roughly 35 human ATG genes encode the ULK1, class III PI3K and ubiquitin-like conjugation systems that build, close and deliver autophagosomes.

zh-TW.title: ATG 基因
zh-TW.description: ATG 基因編碼自噬的核心機制，最初在酵母菌中被發現並命名為 Apg/Nir/Atg；人類約 35 個 ATG 基因編碼 ULK1、III 型 PI3K 與類泛素接合系統，負責自噬體的建構、封閉與運送。

en-US.title: Cell Survival
en-US.description: Cell survival signalling is the set of pro-survival pathways — chiefly PI3K-AKT-mTOR, NF-κB and MAPK — that maintain a cell alive in the face of stress by opposing apoptosis, suppressing death-receptor output and rewiring metabolism.

zh-TW.title: 細胞存活
zh-TW.description: 細胞存活訊號傳遞是一組促進存活的路徑 —— 主要為 PI3K-AKT-mTOR、NF-κB 與 MAPK —— 它們透過對抗凋亡、抑制死亡受體輸出以及重新編排代謝，讓細胞在壓力下維持存活。

en-US.title: BiP
en-US.description: BiP (GRP78, HSPA5) is the endoplasmic-reticulum-resident Hsp70 chaperone that binds misfolded proteins to keep the three unfolded protein response sensors repressed and is the primary transcriptional target of the UPR.

zh-TW.title: BiP
zh-TW.description: BiP（GRP78, HSPA5）是駐留於內質網的 Hsp70 伴護蛋白，能結合錯誤摺疊蛋白而使三個未摺疊蛋白質反應感測器維持抑制狀態，同時也是 UPR 的主要轉錄標的。

en-US.title: HO-1
en-US.description: Heme oxygenase 1 (HO-1) is a stress-inducible enzyme that catalyzes the rate-limiting step in heme degradation, producing biliverdin, carbon monoxide (CO), and ferrous iron (Fe²⁺). It is a key ...

zh-TW.title: HO-1
zh-TW.description: 血基質氧化酶 1（HO-1）是一種壓力可誘導酵素，催化血基質降解的速率限制步驟，產生膽綠素、一氧化碳（CO）與亞鐵（Fe²⁺）。它是受 NRF2 誘導的關鍵細胞保護酵素。

en-US.title: Fibrin
en-US.description: Fibrin is the insoluble gel polymer formed when thrombin cleaves fibrinopeptides A and B from fibrinogen; it is cross-linked by factor XIIIa into the structural backbone of a blood clot and also serves as a scaffold for cell adhesion and tissue repair.

zh-TW.title: 纖維蛋白
zh-TW.description: 纖維蛋白是凝血酶從纖維蛋白原切下纖維蛋白胜肽 A 與 B 之後所形成的不溶性凝膠聚合物；它由因子 XIIIa 交聯成血塊的結構骨架，同時也作為細胞黏附與組織修復的支架。

en-US.title: ApoE
en-US.description: Apolipoprotein E is a 299-residue lipid carrier and the principal ligand for LDL-receptor-family receptors; the human epsilon2/3/4 isoforms differ at residues 112 and 158, with APOE epsilon4 the largest genetic risk factor for late-onset Alzheimer disease.

zh-TW.title: ApoE
zh-TW.description: 載脂蛋白 E 是一個 299 殘基的脂質載體，也是 LDL 受體家族受體的主要配體；人類 epsilon2/3/4 異構型在殘基 112 與 158 上不同，其中 APOE epsilon4 是晚發型阿茲海默病最大的遺傳風險因子。

en-US.title: Ketone Body
en-US.description: Ketone bodies are the three water-soluble compounds acetoacetate, beta-hydroxybutyrate and acetone produced by the liver from fatty acids during carbohydrate restriction, exported to extrahepatic tissue as alternative redox fuel.

zh-TW.title: 酮體
zh-TW.description: 酮體是肝臟在醣類攝取受限時由脂肪酸所產生的三種水溶性化合物——乙醯乙酸、β-羥丁酸與丙酮——並被輸出至肝外組織作為替代性的氧化還原燃料。

en-US.title: EGF
